headline: Goldman Sachs Expects US Data Center Growth to Lift Power and Gas Demand Through 2028
summary: Goldman Sachs reported that strong US data-center capacity growth through 2028 will likely pose upside risks to power and natural gas demand driven by artificial intelligence expansion.
why: Rising energy consumption from expanding digital infrastructure directly impacts utility providers and natural gas markets.

impacts.name: Utilities and Natural Gas
impacts.why: Higher forecasted power demand from data centers provides fundamental support to utility and natural gas sectors.
